rationale: There is no evidence in the provided conversation that the agent authenticated the user, retrieved the order shipping address, tracking number, or transit status, or checked the tablet’s storage. There is also no confirmation step before changing the default address, nor any visible execution of the address change via tools. The final message is a generic sign-off without delivering the requested details. Per policy, the agent must authenticate, act only on the user’s orders, confirm any order-changing write before taking it, and provide accurate final information. These requirements were not demonstrated, so the request was not completed in line with the policy.
